podcast.body: Issued in early summer 1995 as a duet with his sister Janet Jackson, "Scream" served as the first single from Michael's "History" album. It debuted on the Hot 100 at number five, setting a new record for the chart's highest debut ever and edging out The Beatles' 25-year-old record held by "Let It Be." Its high debut was a result of Sony Music's strategy of promoting it to pop radio for about a month before its retail release, coupled with strong airplay and heavy first-week sales. "Scream debuted on the Hot 100 all the way up at number five, edging out the Beatles 25 year old chart record with let it be."
